label: Download Manager
description: Fetches a file to the user's download folder. Works without opening the manager; when it is open the download joins its list with the usual progress and completion announcement. Any add-on that needs to fetch a file for the user should call this rather than downloading on its own.

actions.name: download
actions.summary: Download a file from a web address to the user's download folder. Does not need the Download Manager open.

url.description: Full http:// or https:// address of the file.

folder.description: Save it here instead of the usual download folder.

actions.name: get_download_folder
actions.summary: Say where downloads are being saved.

path.description: The folder to save downloads in.
